the review content variables are the best predictors of review helpfuliness, followed by reviewer variables and the state of the art baseline model.

(1) the proposed novel review content features are effective predictors of review help-fulness and (2) the reviewer helpfulness per days is an important indicator of reviewer helpfulness.
